newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Monkey King says plans B share offer.
newsitem.headline: Monkey King says plans B share offer.

text.p: Welding materials producer Hubei Monkey King Co Ltd said on Wednesday shareholders would vote next month on a plan to launch an issue of class B equity.

A company spokesman said Monkey King planned to offer 50 million class B shares as market conditions ripened and to list the equity in Shenzhen. The firm had received the go-ahead from the Shenzhen Securities Management Office last year, he said.
China Securities Co Ltd has been appointed the domestic lead underwriter for the issue, with Peregrine Capital Ltd as the international coordinator, said the official.
Monkey King planned to channel the proceeds into expanding the company's production of welding materials, he added.

At the shareholders meeting on October 8, shareholders would also need to approve a plan to make a two-for-10 scrip payout as the company's interim dividend for 1996, it said in a notice published in the Securities Times.

Monkey King said in its interim report for 1996 that under Chinese accounting standards it posted an unaudited net earnings of 50.58 million yuan in the first half, compared with 53.90 million yuan in the same period of last year.
The company says it has a 15 percent share of the domestic market.
